task.title: Referred training not confirmed — No training information on file

step.cmd: In NWS, create a REM WI as follows:

ul.li: Due date: Enter the current day + 10 business days.
Details: Type “Claim to be calculated without training information. Pending for confirmation of referral. If not received, adjudicate as non-referred training.”
Destination: Enter the SCC as shown in FTS.

step.cmd: Determine if the benefit type is CCB:
In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “CCB — Awaiting referred training confirmation.”

Details: Type “The claim must be finalized without training input. Confirmation of referred training is required. If the referred training is not confirmed, the training must be adjudicated as non-referred training. To document other details, refer to Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: On the Resolve Issue tab of the ADJ WI for the training issue, complete the Level 1 Training screen as follows:

ul.li: Select Adjudication of training is not required .

Explain why adjudication is not required: Type “The claim has been finalized without training input. Confirmation of referred training is required. If the referred training is not confirmed, the training must be adjudicated as non-referred training.”

step.cmd: Verify the information on the Record of Decision screen:
Complete the ADJ WI for the training issue.
When the REM WI moves to the current workload, determine if the Claim action status is finalized :

ul.li: If the BP is established, go to step 8.
If the BP is not established, go to step 18.

If the Claim action status is not finalized , move the WI to Pending as follows, then repeat step 7:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for confirmation of training.”
Bring forward date: Enter the current date + 5 business days.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
In NWS and Imaging, determine if the referred training information is on file:

ul.li: If the referred training information is not on file but the 10-day pending period from establishing the claim has not been reached, move the WI to Pending for the remainder of the 10-day period. When the WI moves to the current workload, repeat step 9.
If the referred training information is not on file and the 10-day pending period is reached, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Determine if the client declared the training between September 27, 2020 and September 25, 2021:

ul.li: If yes, refer to the appropriate non-referred training procedure for the type of special benefits being claimed. non-referred training
If it is a claim for CCB, refer to Adjudicating non-referred training: CCB — Continuing claim . Adjudicating non-referred training: CCB — Continuing claim
For all other special benefit types, except claims for maternity benefits only, go to step 12.
If it is a claim for maternity benefits only, go to step 13.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and impose a manual action to stop payments (MA72) as follows:

ul.li: Manual Action: Select 72 - Additional Training information required .

step.cmd: In NWS, double-select the resolved training issue. Under Decision Options , select Decision no longer valid .
Refer to the appropriate non-referred training procedure for the type of special benefits being claimed.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 36 - Special benefits on Fishing claims or other complex claim conditions .
Remarks Line 2: Type “T171 — STRT-WK/DY [the course start w/c], END-WK-DY [the course end w/c].”

Remarks Line 3: Type “PROJ-HRRC [the Responsibility Centre code or institution code, if applicable], PROJ-NO [the 10-digit agreement number; use preceding zeros if the number is less than 10 digits], TRAIN-ID [the training ID code], BREAK START/END WK [the w/c code of any break weeks].”

Remarks Line 4: Type “[Type of benefits to be paid, if not already on the claim. (Mat — w/c xxxx-xxxx, Par — w/c xxxx-xxxx, family caregiver weeks or CCB weeks to be paid)].” If applicable, type “[NO-CR] or [claimant’s report information], etc.”

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the REM WI for the training issue.
